title: Garima Gospels
summary: Two Gospel books kept at the Abba Garima monastery near Adwa in northern Ethiopia were dated by radiocarbon to the late fifth to early seventh centuries, far earlier than the turn of the first millennium once assumed. Their illustrations and text rank among the earliest surviving manuscripts illustrated with Christian images, and the text is a rare witness to the Aksumite Ethiopic language.

uncertainty.note: Radiocarbon analysis gave "late 5th-early 7th centuries" (Ethiopian Heritage Fund); Oxford testing of two fragments reported "somewhere between 330 and 650 AD" (Medievalists.net). Years 475-625 interpret the first phrase; the range extends to 330-650 AD.
